title: WRAP: Fixtureless Wrench-aware Multi-Robot Assembly Planning
title_zh: WRAP：无需夹具的扳手感知多机器人装配规划
abstract: Assembly using robots often requires specially designed fixtures, or relies on top-down only assembly strategies. Using multiple robots, we can avoid using fixtures and make robotic assembly more flexible. Planning assembly sequences for multiple robots is challenging due to the high number of possible task assignments and orders. In addition, we need to reason over forces that occur during the assembly process, e.g., to decide if multiple robots are required for support, or if external support such as a table should be used.   We present Wrap, a multi-robot assembly planner for multi-part assemblies, given the inter-part ordering-dependencies, the part meshes, and their initial state. We formulate a linear program to reason about valid grasps for supporting the forces that occur during assembly. The search leverages the assembly sequence, and greedily finds a feasible solution per assembly step by computing a heuristic via a cheap backwards search, and using the heuristic in the more expensive forward search.   We then solve the multi-robot, multi-goal motion planning problem, and for execution, we split the plan into contact-rich assembly skills, and free space motion. We benchmark the planner on a variety of multi-part assemblies, and apply the planner to groups of robots differing in size and kinematics. We validate the work both in a physics simulation, and in real. Videos and code are available at https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap.
abstract_zh: 使用机器人进行装配通常需要专门设计的夹具，或者仅依赖自上而下的装配策略。通过使用多个机器人，我们可以避免使用夹具，并使机器人装配更加灵活。由于可能的任务分配和顺序数量众多，为多个机器人规划装配序列具有挑战性。此外，我们需要对装配过程中产生的力进行推理，例如决定是否需要多个机器人提供支撑，或者是否应使用桌子等外部支撑。我们提出了Wrap，一种用于多零件装配的多机器人装配规划器，给定零件间的顺序依赖关系、零件网格及其初始状态。我们构建了一个线性规划来推理有效的抓取，以支撑装配过程中产生的力。搜索利用装配序列，并通过廉价的向后搜索计算启发式，然后在更昂贵的前向搜索中使用该启发式，从而贪婪地为每个装配步骤找到可行解。然后，我们解决多机器人、多目标的运动规划问题，并在执行时，将计划分解为接触丰富的装配技能和自由空间运动。我们在各种多零件装配上对规划器进行基准测试，并将其应用于不同尺寸和运动学的机器人组。我们在物理仿真和真实环境中验证了这项工作。视频和代码可在 https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap 获取。
tldr_zh: 提出WRAP规划器，无需夹具实现多机器人多零件装配。
cover_zh: 不用夹具也能装配？多机器人协作新思路｜力推理+序列规划
